label: kizuna_dragon_b_02
text: I try to visit the schoolyard from time to time.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_b_03
text: It’s good to see young ones with so much energy\nand vigor...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_b_04a
text: Oh, yes indeed. Just watching is enough to make\neven an old man like me feel more alive.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_b_04b
text: Do you? That’s a bit of a surprise to hear you say.\nYou’re one of the young ones too, you know.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_b_tamer_01
text: Master Hassel. Might I have a word?

label: kizuna_dragon_b_05
text: You... What are you doing here?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_b_06
text: I have told you many times not to bother me\nhere at the academy.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_b_tamer_02
text: Yet, I am bound to come. Our family’s future is of\nparamount importance.

label: kizuna_dragon_b_09
text: Something important has come up, so I must\nexcuse myself now.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: kizuna_dragon_b_system_01
text: You became even closer with Mr. Hassel!

label: kizuna_dragon_b_10
text: Let us discuss this matter elsewhere. Come...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]
